title: Secret-manager pointers: must be flagged
summary: Values that only imitate a secret-manager grammar (a malformed pointer around a real-looking identifier). Covers 4 inputs.
rationale: Secret-manager pointers name where a secret lives without disclosing it. Each manager has its own grammar, so a fix for one leaves the others.

expectation.rationale: Mutated documentation, placeholder, template, mask or reference. Expected masking follows a redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
